Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner suggested using “Travis Scott” as a possible performer when framing follow-up searches (confusing Mac Miller’s “Goosebumpz” with Travis Scott’s “Goosebumps”). This misidentification could have led to the wrong artist and an incorrect release date, though later steps corrected course and arrived at the correct March 11, 2011 date.
